subject: Math
prompt: The function $g$ is defined by $g(x) = 3|x|$. What is the value of $g(-7)$?
explanation: Choice A is correct. To evaluate $g(-7)$, substitute $x = -7$ into the function definition $g(x) = 3|x|$, which gives $g(-7) = 3|-7|$. The absolute value of $-7$ is $|-7| = 7$, since absolute value converts any negative number to its positive counterpart. Therefore, $g(-7) = 3(7) = 21$.
